scope: Descriptive scalar contract; accept_binding.py is the fail-closed paired validator

metrics.scope: Same-runtime monotonic clock and whole-runtime cumulative counters

worker-phase-1.json.points_array_order: Storage order differs from chronological order; index by unique phase name

capture-host.json.deadline: post_edit_deadline_monotonic_ms must equal edit_dispatched_monotonic_ms + 90000, with no extra export grace

memory-profile.json.requirements: Fresh distinct profile/addon, exactly one public persisted preference delta, effective readback matches, before-timed-gui, no GUI initialization

openracket-gui-phase-manifest.json.required: compiled true, integer compile_exit_code 0, exact arm original_pins and common stock_pins, actual source/helper hashes, exact helper paths, byte-for-byte undo and reapplication of common transform

failure_policy: Preserve all partial files/logs; cancellation, OOM, timeout, missing/ambiguous endpoints, mismatched identity/counts, malformed data or skipped native gates never mean success.

activation.json.requirements: Actual already-instantiated resolved GUI module at phase zero, exact transformed GUI source hash from verified manifest, stock export absent/flag unset or candidate export true/flag1, GUI handler thread, producer points off

heartbeat.json.scope: One outstanding low-priority callback, closed-loop interval from previous handler; no physical input latency or typing claim
heartbeat.json.tail_gap: Frozen at stop against latest pre-stop handler or start; after-stop drain may update last_handler separately
heartbeat.json.success: No errors/drops/outstanding callbacks, joined producer, nonempty actual application-window coverage, exact timestamp arithmetic, post-join final validation inside original deadline

pair_acceptance.normalization: Typed verified clone-relative module/hash/export/monitor identity only. Raw module_spec and terminal source association retained.
pair_acceptance.source_deltas: Only pinned original GUI production delta; identical common additive transform with exact arm-specific undo and actual installed source verification
pair_acceptance.matrix_requirement: All six export objects must match exactly including canonical digest, key_count and edge_count; six fresh profiles/addons; same normalized verified registry/terminal/monitor/source/prefab/settings

binding-export.json.candidate_state_contract: Before: enabled/active true, accepted=pending>0, generation>0, materializations/stock_calls/unsupported_fallbacks=0, fallback_reason=false. First: enabled true, active false, pending 0, materializations1, stock_calls=before.pending, fallback_reason public-exposure, accepted/duplicates/generation/unsupported_fallbacks unchanged. Second state identical to first. accepted=edge_count. Counter fields exact nonnegative integers; no bool counters.
binding-export.json.export_contract: Nonempty mutable strong equal? hash, nonempty immutable strong equal? sets, exact in-range owning-editor endpoint triples; counts 1..300000, key_count<=edge_count; full sorted exact-integer quadruples written by Racket then SHA256. No raw payload in evidence.
binding-export.json.command_timing: Both command start/end snapshots exclude state reads, progress callbacks, full graph walking and reporting; first command begins only after primary completion, heartbeat join and post-join verification. Second getter returns same hash identity.
binding-export.json.final_recheck: verified_monotonic_ms <= post_export_final_verification_monotonic_ms < original deadline; current request/source/lexer are rechecked after full export validation
binding-export.json.failure: Partial scalar progress retained with verified false, status failed and bounded exception text when available
